entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: Huge evil being on Arcavios, temporarily summoned by Extus Narr.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Oriq who summoned the Blood Avatar to destroy Strixhaven.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Faction to which Extus Narr belongs.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane where the Blood Avatar was summoned.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Planeswalker twin who fought the Blood Avatar and lost his right leg at the knee.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Planeswalker twin who tapped the Snarl's energy against the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: The Snarl
entities.description: Source of energy Rowan tapped and into which the Blood Avatar was pulled back.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: Place that collapsed during the fight.

events.summary: Extus Narr summons the Blood Avatar to unleash destruction upon Strixhaven.
events.quote: Extus Narr summoned the Blood Avatar to unleash destruction upon Strixhaven

events.summary: The Blood Avatar crushes Extus, then cuts off Will's right leg at the knee as it is pulled into the Snarl.
events.quote: grievously injuring Will by cutting his right leg off at the knee

events.summary: Deans Nassari and Lisette save the twins from the collapsing Hall of Oracles.
events.quote: The Hall of Oracles collapsed, but the twins were saved by Deans Nassari and Lisette .

relations.quote: temporarily summoned by the Oriq Extus Narr
temporarily summoned by the Oriq Extus Narr

rejected.summary: Rowan taps the Snarl's energy at great personal cost and temporarily disrupts the Blood Avatar; Extus mocks her.
rejected.quote: Rowan tapped the Snarl 's energy, gaining immense power but at great personal cost.
